versioning.displayVersion: full appSemver from 1.2.0; preserve historical major.minor labels
versioning.sourceDirectories: versioned source directories use original repository name plus upstream tag, such as supersplat-v2.28.0
rules: Every upstream editor sync records the SuperSplat tag, dependency set, and Metaflow customizations.
Versioned supersplat-v* source directories are the rebuild source of truth for metaflow-editor.
Generated /data/editor-version-history.json and /editor/version.json must match this metadata file.
From Editor 1.2.0, displayVersion equals full appSemver; current is the default edition and compatibility pins the WebGL2 source/runtime. A repository candidate is not proof of production deployment.

entries.summary: Native background picker with inline colour palette and Figma-style numeric scrubbing

changes.summary: Match native swatches and PCUI theme; compact inline SV/hue/alpha palette, HEX/RGB selection and stable stop editing in both editions.
Label or Option/Alt numeric dragging with four speed bands, single-step undo, cancellation and pointer-capture fallback; retain existing rendering and settings contracts.

entries.summary: Normalize legacy RGBA background tuples before shared RGB sampling; recover gradient release

changes.summary: Preserve four-component legacy background settings on the wire; write exactly RGB plus alpha to the gradient texture and retain ordinary RGB behavior.
Add LUT overflow regression and WebGL/WebGPU old RGBA-scene coverage after rolling back the initial gradient deployment.

entries.summary: Shared solid, multi-stop linear and radial background picker in both Editor editions

changes.summary: Popover stop editing, alpha, angle/radial geometry, single-gesture undo and project persistence with legacy bgColor.
Shared screen-space background composition for both backends, PNG and ordinary/particle/360 video; transparent exports bypass the layer.
Gradient HTML/Package/legacy ZIP use a self-contained Metaflow Viewer; settings remain version 2 and solid exports retain the previous path.
Shared background, picker and standalone Viewer source/artifact fingerprints reject stale export runtimes.

entries.summary: Adopt SuperSplat 3.5.2 and release deterministic particle video with a WebGL2 compatibility edition

changes.summary: Default Editor adopts pinned SuperSplat 3.5.2 / PlayCanvas 2.23.0; immutable older source snapshots remain available.
/editor-legacy/ uses SuperSplat 2.32.5 and WebGL2, including the same Metaflow exports, long timeline and particle-video options.
Retain 100000 frames, Metaflow branding, upstream HTML/Package, five-file legacy ZIP and settings-only JSON.
Render characterSog or streamingScene reveal with deterministic camera/frame clocks, stable offline GPU ordering, transactional cancellation and recovery.
Retire only Editor-owned offline caches without reloading unsaved tabs; both editions revalidate their assets.
Build-time source digests and staged file hashes reject stale mirrors before a site build.

Retain upstream BlobReadSource, BufferedReadStream 4MB buffering, and streaming zip project load behavior from v2.28.0.
